concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The agreement expressly states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, while effectiveness was deferred from the signing date.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by talus ventures ab in fjordsignal as's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by Talus Ventures AB in FjordSignal AS's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The agreement identifies this as the sole Permitted Purpose and excludes other transaction types and uses.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: Although the ordinary disclosure window ends on 31 January 2028, the executed termination notice delivered on 24 November closes it effective 30 November 2027.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as a party registered in Norway and serving as the Discloser.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as a party registered in Sweden and serving as the Recipient.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: LUMEN retains trade-secret protection, SHORE is protected as a complete package despite prior possession of one component, CEDAR had not yet been publicly released, and BASALT's public disclosure resulted from a breach. ORACLE was in a protection gap at the snapshot, while MICA was excluded by proven independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five Business Days after the 25 March oral disclosure, while excluding 26 and 29 March, makes 5 April the final delivery date. The deadline expires at 17:00 UTC, and delivery requires arrival in the recipient mailbox.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection was provisional and continuous from the oral disclosure on 25 march 2027 through the confirmation deadline on 5 april at 17:00 utc. because the confirmation was delivered on 6 april, after the deadline, protection ended at that deadline and a gap continued until the recipient accepted it on 8 april; that acceptance restored protection prospectively only. sending on 5 april did not suffice because delivery depends on mailbox arrival, not dispatch.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection was provisional and continuous from the oral disclosure on 25 March 2027 through the confirmation deadline on 5 April at 17:00 UTC. Because the confirmation was delivered on 6 April, after the deadline, protection ended at that deadline and a gap continued until the Recipient accepted it on 8 April; that acceptance restored protection prospectively only. Sending on 5 April did not suffice because delivery depends on mailbox arrival, not dispatch.
justifications: The oral-information rule provides provisional protection before the deadline, continuous protection only with timely confirmation, and prospective restoration after late acceptance without covering the intervening gap. Mailbox arrival, rather than sending, determines delivery.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: Prior possession is established only for the smaller incorporated module, not for the new branching map, thresholds, or complete package. An exclusion for a component does not exclude the complete disclosed combination.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire ordinary schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on 15 June 2027. That release ends protection for the exact information released, overriding the otherwise longer ordinary duration.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin satisfies the employee, undertaking, security-check, and clean-room approval requirements. Marek qualifies as an employee of an affiliate with more than 50% countable voting control, and Oskar qualifies as a professional adviser relying on his enforceable professional duty; both also satisfy the LUMEN-specific requirements.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient controls 48% of the votes directly plus 4% under a presently effective irrevocable proxy. These disjoint voting interests total 52%, while revocable proxies and non-voting interests are excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's undertaking and security check were effective by 10 September, but his named clean-room approval expressly became effective on 14 September. The affiliate voting arrangements were also operating by that date, so access could not begin earlier.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notification was initially prohibited, the deadline was six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted. The prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July 2027, making the deadline 17:20 that day, earlier than the production time.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice arrived at 17:55, while the contractual deadline was 17:20. The actual-arrival rule for compelled notices applies, so the notice was 35 whole minutes late.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order required all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P2 and P4 were withdrawn, while P3B was privileged and outside the final production duty.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November 2027, which is earlier than effective termination. Counting ten Business Days after that trigger, excluding the specified non-business days, ends on 8 December; the restored working copy remains subject to this original deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The backup may remain until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite or 45 calendar days after the Section 7.1 trigger. The scheduled overwrite on 30 December 2027 is earlier, and restoration does not restart the backup clock.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: The segregated counsel-held archive and immutable backup qualify for the custody exception, while the identified bundle remains subject to a binding preservation order. The active working copy and recorded notes are not permitted retention under the stated exceptions.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Residual-knowledge permission excludes deliberately recorded notes, source-related material, quantitative parameters and reconstructed material. Training is independently prohibited without a separate signed licence, which is absent here.
